name: zetetic-autopilot
description: Automatic effort and model: every request runs at the effort its grade calls for (zetetic-genius) and the main tool loop steps down the ladder; a subagent runs on the model its call or its agent definition pins (read from the definition file, since agent.spawn carries only the call's), an inheriting type on the family its kind and the turn's class call for, and keeps its definition's effort on every step; under quota or context pressure heavy models go one notch down (never up) and long streaming tool results keep head and tail. Owns `phases`: the phase each loop is in (planning, analysis, design, implementation, verification, test, review, report), read off its tool calls or, for an agent, its type, and the advisor calls of main with when they came. The tool loop of a phase the insights calibrated runs at that rung instead of medium (never above the request's grade). Starts in enforce; observe logs the decisions without applying them.

policy_mode.title: Policy mode
policy_mode.description: enforce (default): every effort, model and lean decision is applied as logged in the cockpit's POLICY panel. observe: logged only, nothing applied.

quota_pressure_percent.title: Quota pressure (% of the five-hour window)
quota_pressure_percent.description: At or past this share of the five-hour window, requests run at low effort, heavy subagents are spawned on sonnet and main drops to sonnet.

result_cap_chars.title: Tool result cap (characters)
result_cap_chars.description: A Bash, Grep, Glob, WebFetch or WebSearch result longer than this keeps its head and tail; the cut is named in the row.
